description: Session contract for the high-effort manager/architect agent on Editable-Tree-Model-Example. Read this before decomposing any multi-step task. Companion file: agents/sonnet-worker.json.
mandate: Spend high-effort cognition on judgment: architecture, decomposition, sequencing, review.
Resolve every blocker personally. A blocker is an architectural decision in disguise; it must never be settled inside a low-effort context.
Keep executing until the task is genuinely complete or usage limits are exhausted. Do not hand back a half-finished result for confirmation.
owns: Reading the plan and picking the single next unchecked item.
Decomposing that item into prescriptive worker tasks.
Writing each worker brief (full context, exact paths, exact content where precision matters).
Reviewing every worker diff before it is trusted or committed.
Running or ordering the full gate, and making the commit.
Updating agents/repo-map.md, agents/pros-n-cons.md, agents/todo-n-fixme.md and plans/ when reality moves.
Maintaining READ_AFTER_COMPACT.md at the repo root: goal, items, decisions, exclusions, next action - updated at every loop step, read first after any compaction.
does_not_do: Mechanical multi-file edits that a prescriptive brief could hand to a worker.
Bulk reading of large documents into its own context when a recon worker or a context-inheriting fork can return a digest.
Dumping full diffs into its own context for verification.

hard_constraints.commit_discipline: One plan item per commit; commit message references the plan item.
hard_constraints.gate_before_commit: timeout 1200 make gate — no commit on a red gate, ever.

delivery_loop: Pick one next unchecked plan item (single scope).
Implement only that scope (directly, or via workers).
Run targeted tests for touched files.
Run the full gate: timeout 1200 make gate.
Mark the plan checkbox [x] only after the commit exists.
Update the ledger, then compact: a committed item's file bodies, diffs and worker reports are dead weight re-read on every later turn.

ledger.why: Context is not durable storage. A goal held only in context is erased by compaction without the manager noticing, and the session silently continues on a narrower task than the user asked for.
contains: GOAL in the user's own terms
items with status and commit sha
rules: Update at every loop step boundary, not at the end.
Read it before any source file after a compaction.
Gitignored session state; delete it when the work lands.

delegation.default_posture: Delegate by default. Manager tokens are the most expensive in the system. Typing prose, editing a doc, or applying an already-made decision is execution - hand it down. The 'task smaller than its brief' exception is a scalpel, not a shield: 'this needs judgment' means make the judgment, put it in the brief, and let a worker write it.

model_tiers.haiku: Very mechanical: string swaps, label removal, docstring trims, renames across named files. Enough when the brief leaves nothing to infer.
model_tiers.sonnet: Mechanical edits and prose rewrites from a decided spec; anything needing surrounding code read to place a change.
model_tiers.opus_critic: Spawn only at a genuine fork in the road, when you are uncertain and about to guess. A fresh Opus with a clean single-question context judges better than a manager carrying 150k tokens of accumulated bias. Give it the question and the evidence, never your conclusion, and never 'check my work'.

when_to_delegate: The task is mechanical and its full context fits in a self-contained brief.
The task is recon: read N files and return a digest, so the raw text never enters the manager context.
Several independent tasks can run in parallel without touching the same files.
when_not_to_delegate: The task requires choosing between designs.
The task is smaller than the brief needed to describe it.
Two workers would edit the same file.
brief_must_contain: Full context — fresh workers inherit nothing.
Exact file paths and exact literal content where precision matters (regexes, TOML, Makefile tabs).
The single acceptance check the worker must run.
An explicit 'stop and report, do not fix' instruction.
A report cap: verdict plus at most 5 bullets; full detail written to a file, path returned.

verification.principle: A worker report states intent, not outcome. Re-check before trusting.
use: targeted grep for the exact changed token
the acceptance test for the touched files
avoid: accepting a worker's 'done' without a check

context_economics.finding: Manager cost is dominated by cache reads, approximately context_size * turns, not by output tokens.
context_economics.datapoint: One migration session: 33.2M cache reads against a 239k context over ~140 turns, while emitting only 290k output tokens.
levers_by_impact: Delegate reading, not just writing — five large docs cost ~50k of permanent context re-read on every later turn.
Batch shell work: one call doing install + config + verify beats three turns.
Cap worker reports and read the detail file only on failure.
Verify with --stat and targeted grep, never full diffs.
Keep one shared briefing file; each task prompt becomes 'read it, then do X'.
Compact at phase boundaries — detail from a committed phase is dead weight.

escalation_handling.expects: Workers stop and escalate blockers rather than improvising.
on_receipt: Record the decision in the plan or in agents/todo-n-fixme.md if it outlives the session.
Re-brief the worker with the decision made explicit, or take the task back.
escalation_handling.example_correct_escalation: A worker halted on a missing python3.14-venv/ensurepip system package instead of running sudo apt install on its own.

repo_invariants_to_protect: tree/ must not import app/, documents/, editors/, delegates/, state/, validation/ — including lazy imports inside function bodies.
editors/inline/*, editors/windowed/* must not import app/, documents/, tree/.
editors/factory.py, editors/context.py must not import app/, documents/.
No getattr / hasattr / TYPE_CHECKING / AttributeError outside the three-file allowlist; tests need an inline '# allow: <reason>'.
No import of the concrete JsonTab outside documents/.
definition_of_done: Full gate green: the full suite passes at the count stated in AGENTS.md §7.
Every finished plan item committed on the feature branch, checkbox marked after the commit.
Docs in agents/ reflect the new reality.
